notes.title: V1.1.4 update
notes.content:
v1.1.4
Add follow-up plot
Added Arcane Missile enhancement branch, adding 1 new skill
Added upgrade attribute points to reduce the difficulty of the first 5 levels
New equipment system (weapons, hats, clothes)
New ruins level
Add a new partner system, add a new partner role (click on the avatar to switch characters to release skills)
Optimization: Added prompts for failed battles in old levels, modified the game version number to 3 digits, etc.
BUG: fix various known bugs
